Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥1,433 million.

entries.63a5f6a358540813: An in-house search engine that collectively searches across documents and data stored in different environments, such as file servers, portal sites and online storage. Provision began in 2012, supporting productivity improvement for white-collar workers by making search work more efficient. The company also offers the generative AI chat 'Chat EI,' which applies this technology. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.64f4041382f225f3: A service that provides AI which outputs motion from data such as images, video, and force and contact information, combining recognition technology developed with 'Impulse' and a robot foundation model, and that handles the on-site implementation of robots. Its configuration does not depend on specific machines or manufacturers, and its feature is that motion assets can be reused even when the machine changes. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.66247eb0fec1fc80: The auto-modeling function for anomaly detection allows data analysis to begin without reliance on advanced analytical skills. Since going into production in 2016, customers have achieved full in-house operation of “Impulse”, and in the analysis services segment of the domestic predictive detection solutions market it has held the No. 1 share from fiscal 2023 through fiscal 2025. For the fiscal year ended July 2026, the software sales ratio was 66% and the stock revenue ratio, which reflects revenue expected to continue, was 34%, and license sales reached 603 units.
entries.697f7d7f8f6a6e68: Customers using the software are concentrated in 3 industries (manufacturing, information and communications, and public administration), which account for most revenue; by size, large enterprises account for nearly half.
entries.92f1600a4bc03177: A company that provides "Impulse," an anomaly detection solution that builds AI into companies' operations, and "Neuron Enterprise Search," an in-company search engine.
entries.a3841fb795cf98e2: The [Business Overview] states that customers using the software are mainly in 3 industries (manufacturing, information and communications, and public administration), which account for most revenue; that by customer size, large enterprises account for nearly half; and that it will seek to enter new industries and expand into small and medium-sized enterprises. The principal customer information in the Segment Information, etc. states that there is no counterparty accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.a4303e96bce505f8: An all-in-one AI platform that collects device data, sensor data, and video and image data, and supports everything from building AI analysis models to operating them. Used for quality inspection and routine inspection in manufacturing, failure prediction for construction machinery, and anomaly detection in plants, contributing to more advanced operations and labor savings. Provision began in 2014, and it has held first place in market share in the analysis services segment of Japan's predictive detection solution market from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2025. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.b069fe8d773403c6: A service that provides AI which outputs motion from data such as images, video, and force and contact information, combining recognition technology developed with 'Impulse' and a robot foundation model, and that handles the on-site implementation of robots.
entries.ba9683382c47d6bf: Net income for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥192 million. The previous fiscal year was ¥133 million.
entries.c958e4a8f19ceb72: A service that builds AI agents incorporating business knowledge such as customers' work procedures and judgment criteria, handling everything from information gathering and analysis to judgment, task execution and reporting. The main application areas are manufacturing, construction sites, and the knowledge work that supports them. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.d85bab058a84b70f: Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥1,433 million, up 14.1% from the previous fiscal year. Revenue by category was software license sales ¥457 million, implementation support work ¥484 million, and software maintenance and usage services ¥491 million.
entries.f9b0952664fb8cef: It has set a mission of “contributing to dramatic improvements in the continuity and productivity of corporate activities”, and aims to remain a group of engineers who create a bright future, with its advanced open-technology utilization capability and distinctive high technical capability as sources of competitiveness. It states that it will continue to promote its two existing software packages, the anomaly detection solution “Impulse” and the enterprise search engine “Neuron Enterprise Search”, and will expand its business areas through increased sales of new services such as physical AI and robot implementation support services and business-specific AI agents. Issues to be addressed include responding to new technologies, securing personnel, and strengthening development and sales systems.
entries.fa6b6559725172c9: The company has a single segment, the enterprise AI software business; its customers are concentrated in 3 industries (manufacturing, information and communications, and public administration), and large enterprises account for nearly half of revenue. No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue. It states it will seek to expand its business by entering new industries and expanding into small and medium-sized enterprises.
